title: TenantCreated, version 1 (payload)
description: The payload of TenantCreated v1 (producer tenant-merchant, topic tenant-merchant.events, key = tenant ID). It is the 'payload' property of an envelope that validates against envelope.v1.schema.json. The event states the complete, committed creation of a tenant: its tenant row, merchant profile, initial MerchantOwner membership and audit record. Contract: docs/events/TENANT_MERCHANT_EVENTS.md. Additional properties are allowed so that optional properties added later in v1 never invalidate messages for existing consumers.

slug.description: The tenant's immutable, platform-unique handle: 3 to 63 lowercase ASCII letters, digits and single hyphens, starting and ending with a letter or digit (TenantSlug).

displayName.description: The merchant's public display name at creation, exactly as stored (MerchantDisplayName): trimmed of .NET white space, 1 to 200 UTF-16 code units, no control characters (Unicode category Cc). It never starts or ends with white space and is never white space only. maxLength counts code points, so it is never stricter than the producer's code-unit limit.

status.description: The tenant status at creation. Open set: new values may appear within v1 and consumers must handle unknown values without treating them as any known value (see the contract). Known values: Active.

origin.description: How the tenant was created. Open set: new values may appear within v1 and consumers must handle unknown values (see the contract). Informational only: never an authorization input. Known values: Provisioned, SelfService.
